Seats

People with portal access to this vendor. A seat is a login, not a subscription. Removing a seat does not change the vendor's subscriptions or anything its other colleagues can do. Products

Every product this vendor owns, including the ones it co-owns with another vendor. Catalog records reach AECi through the review app's promote step, not from this screen. Each row's Actions menu changes the logo or hides the product from the public site. On a connector it also sets the connector type and lists the integrations that run through it.
